title: Flat pullback map for Rees algebras
statement:
For a quasi-coherent ideal $\mathcal I\subseteq\mathcal O_X$ and flat
$g\colon Y\to X$, define $\beta_g$ degreewise by the canonical
maps

$$
g^*(\mathcal I^n)\longrightarrow
(\mathcal I\mathcal O_Y)^n.
$$

Thus

$$
\beta_g\colon g^*\mathcal R_X(\mathcal I)\longrightarrow
\mathcal R_Y(\mathcal I\mathcal O_Y).
$$

blueprint_notes.text:
**Status.** Bypassed by the formalized route: blow-ups are never
base-changed along a flat morphism. Every base-change step the route takes
goes through the universal property
`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.exists_lift_blowup` and
the chart pullback squares
`AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.IdealSheafData.isPullback_blowup$\iota$`
instead.

split_report.summary: Q138 repair of the reader-approved delivery returned at ec201c91edc. Re-read all six current dependency statements and retained the source statement verbatim. The extended ideal J = I O_Y is now defined by def-nagata-extended-ideal as the kernel of the base-changed closed immersion. The construction uses lemma-nagata-flat-pullback-ideal-pow, not the definition, for the image equality im(c_n) = J^n, where c_n is g^*(I^n) -> g^*O_X -> O_Y. Define beta_n as its unique corestriction to this image. On local tensor generators it sends b tensor a to b g-sharp(a); balancing, multiplication, unit and restriction identities give the graded algebra map. The current def-pc-module-pullback supplies the tensor formula and adjunction, and the Mathlib leaf lem-weil-pbc-left-adjoint-preserves-colimits identifies the pullback of the countable direct sum with the direct sum of the pullbacks. The expanded current def-nagata-sheaf-rees-algebra supplies precisely that direct sum, its ideal-power multiplication and degree-zero unit; def-weil-flat-morphism fixes the flatness hypothesis. Corrected the stale image-definition attribution in the retained report and recorded the revalidation against the current kernel convention. No extra kernel/image comparison dependency is needed: the ideal-power lemma already gives every required image equality, including n=1. No new nodes, equivalence claim, or Lean changes. Reader fix (cc review, 2026-10-21): R_Y(I O_Y) and the powers (I O_Y)^n of def-nagata-sheaf-rees-algebra and def-sbc-ideal-sheaf-powers need I O_Y to be quasi-coherent. The kernel-defined extended ideal is the ideal sheaf of the projection p: Y x_X V(I) -> Y, which is a closed immersion by lem-weil-pbc-closed-immersion-base-change, and the ideal sheaf of a closed immersion is quasi-coherent by def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf; both are now stmt_deps.
